Context: 11. Posting of husband and wife at the same station

2. These are only illustrative and not exhaustive. Cases not covered by the guidelines have to be dealt with in the spirit of the guidelines and the objective of enabling a husband and wife to lead a normal family life and ensuring the education and welfare of their children as far as possible and within the constraints of administrative convenience. - Chapter 62.
